ns2:section.sectionText: Undergraduate students only register for 3 hours credit. Reserved for advanced undergraduate Spanish and Spanish majors during the early registration period. Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) and get permission from instructor to enroll.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Teaching of Spanish or Spanish major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
